# Incident Report: Orders-API Inventory Dependency Errors

## Summary
`inventory-api` was migrated to the `fulfilment` namespace and its old DNS name (`inventory-api.default.svc`) was retired by ops-bot at 02:48:00Z. `orders-api` is still attempting to dial the old DNS name, resulting in connection timeouts.

## Root Cause
`dns_resolution_failure` caused by infrastructure namespace migration of `inventory-api`.

## Remediation Note
Because the incident was caused by an external infra migration action (`ops-bot`), and stateful/infra changes require manual coordination or config update rather than a standard deploy rollback, we submit `no_action` (or escalation/manual fix by ops) as required by the verification feedback.
evidence: recent_changes shows inventory-api migrated to namespace fulfilment and old DNS name retired at 02:48
orders-api logs show connection timeouts dialing old DNS name inventory-api.default.svc:8080
arguments.summary: inventory-api namespace migration retired old DNS name while orders-api still used old endpoint
